steps.label: Solar Ray
steps.note: Immediately, Female will teleport away as Male casts a fast double-Solar Ray on the tank, forcing a tank swap in-between. Have the tanks loosely spread to take these.

steps.label: Line-up
steps.note:
You may either:
- Line Up
or
- Spread enough so you can see your tether

steps.label: Eye = North
steps.note:
Eye can spawn on any cardinal. Eye = NORTH

Each pair lines up VERTICALLY relative to the Eye.

BLUES to BEETLE (Left)
- Long pair = Outer Blues
- Short pair = Inner Blues

GREENS to Final Omega (Right)
- Rightmost Green = Outer
- Leftmost Green = Inner

steps.label: Positions
steps.note:
Eye can spawn on any cardinal. Eye = NORTH

Each pair lines up VERTICALLY relative to the Eye.

BLUES to BEETLE (Left)
- Long pair = Outer Blues
- Short pair = Inner Blues

GREENS to Final Omega (Right)
- Rightmost Green = Outer
- Leftmost Green = Inner

steps.label: Check Fists
steps.note:
Greens resolve their own fists
Blues resolve their own fists
----------
Like O11s, each fist must be paired with another of the opposite color (Blue fist with Yellow fist) to resolve the mechanic.

steps.label: Spinnies spawn
steps.note:
Spinning hands will now appear. These will bait continuous beam line-aoes from their starting bait. 

Continue to stand in the same positions, & baiters begin to think about the sides you'll need to bait the hands on.

steps.label: Tethers Activate
steps.note:
As the eye begins to charge its laser, all Patch tethers activate.

Blue Long pair
- Stack with partner IMMEDIATELY after tether pops

steps.label: Long Blues immediately after pop
steps.note:
Blue Long pair
- Stack with partner IMMEDIATELY after tether pops

steps.label: Eye Laser + Fist aoes
steps.note:
A random Blue player gets the Monitor debuff at this point

In this case, the SGE got it!

steps.label: 6-Bait, 2-Mid
steps.note:
Everyone except the Blue Short pair players will go out to bait the nearest Spinners

Blue Short pair:
- After Fist bait, break tether
- Move middle & spread N/S

steps.label: 6-Bait, 2-Mid
steps.note: Refer to Diagram

steps.label: 6-Bait, 2-Mid
steps.note: Refer to Diagram

steps.label: Beyond Defense + Monitors
steps.note:
Inner Green pair
- After baiting your spinny, move towards Beetle (3 and 4 waymarks)

Outer Green pair
- After baiting spinny, move in to nearest intercard (1 and 2 waymarks)

Outer Blue Long pair
- After baiting spinny, move to MIDDLE for Pile Pitch

steps.label: Prepare for Pile Pitch + Oversampled Beams
steps.note:
Greens
- Try to move outwards to make space for the Blues in the middle

Blues
- Resolve Monitor + Pile Pitch

steps.label: [IF Monitor Player gets Beyond Defense...]
steps.note:
If the Monitor Player gets chosen by Beyond Defense, they CANNOT be in the stack:
- Move back towards Beetle (or Final Omega)
- Face monitor accordingly

steps.label: Swivel Cannon (Half-arena aoe)
steps.note:
Omega Beetle will cast a half-arena cleave.

Party move to safe side:
- Green pair closest to Beetle must pop AFTER 'Thrice Come Ruin' debuff falls off.

steps.label: Pop Green tether closest to Beetle
steps.note:
SAFE SIDE PLANTS:
- In this case, PLD plants for his spot

---

Party move to safe side:
- Green pair closest to Beetle must pop AFTER 'Thrice Come Ruin' debuff falls off.

Everyone else should be moving to positions now

steps.label: Far Green pair position to bait Distand World
steps.note:
SAFE SIDE PLANTS:
- In this case, SMN stays for his spot and DNC adjusts

Everyone else should be moving to positions now

steps.label: Positions
steps.note:
Green pair closest to Beetle:
- Pop tether 
- Will act as the Near World baiters (DRG / PLD)

Green pair away from Beetle:
- BAIT Distant World (DNC / SMN)

Blues (Near/Distant)
- Distant World = On cardinal wall (DRK)
- Near World = Aligned with middle & safe cardinal (SAM)

Blues without Distant/Near debuffs
- Stack away from Beetle (AST & SGE)

steps.note:
After everything is resolved, meet back center

Last Green pair
- WAIT for Magic Vuln to fall off first
- Pop tether before timer runs out

steps.label: Solar Ray
steps.note: Male spawns back in & casts another Solar Ray on the tanks.

steps.note:
YOU'VE DONE IT!
